column1: # T10b proposals: SCI driver layer, DISPLAY link (SCI1), key/encoder events. Same format as names_main.tsv.

column3: Peripheral init (R_Systeminit-like): PRCR unlock, ports, all R_SCIn_Create, GROUPBL0 TEI/ERI callback registration
Registers a group-interrupt callback by index (0x14..0x23 = TEI0/ERI0..TEI7/ERI7) [inference]
TEI0 (GROUPBL0 cb 0x14): TXD pin to GPIO, clear TIE/TE/TEIE, transmit-end callback
SCI1 rx byte hook: expected frame length by first byte (06/15=1, Z=len16+4, C3..C5, E0..E8, F0, F1, FD, FE, 'e'), resync on 10-unit gap (timer 1)
CAT mode: cat_rx_complete(3,len), else tuner flag 0xA0A9
CAT framing or tuner framing (first byte 0xA0..0xAF), by sci2_port_mode
NXP ISP (blhost) UART framing 0x5A type len16 crc16, plus 06/'?'/'r' replies
From app_main: sci0_set_baud, displink_uart_start, sci2_configure, sci3_set_baud, SCI4/SCI5 start
Setting 0x9AB7 clamped to 0..3 (2 = CAT, 0 = tuner, 1/3 = off)
CAT framing: ';' end, SPR/SPW/SPNW fixed lengths, E9 bulk, inter-byte timeout from CAT TOT setting
soft_timer_start(id 0..0x4A, n): reload n*10 at 0x209BC, clear expired flag 0x11FED+id
UI/link state init before the power-off loop [inference]
DISPLAY link task (main_loop and power-off loop): rx validate/dispatch, ACK/NAK, gap 2 / ACK-wait 30 units, scheduler, 3 retries
Frame length by type for received frames (0 = unknown -> NAK)
Switch on received type; screen-saver timer restart for all but 06/15/E3
Next frame (scheduler) or resend; after 3 retries drop, link down if hello
ACK: clear outstanding; after the hello reply sets +0x400 (send 0x24)
F0: DISPLAY version/date, boot code b7 (1 reset, 2, 4 numeric mode, 5, 6 link down, 7 destination swap, 0x10 warm), link up, power on (+0x36)
F1 sub: 01 SDR bridge, 02 DSP ISP tunnel, 03 CAT disable (0x20B46), 83 nop
E1 encoder id/step -> main dial / knobs / +0xA3/+0xA4
E4: answer to 0x7B (clears +0x82, set by caller)
MAIN->DISPLAY frame scheduler (priority list in display-link.md)
0x7F (11 bytes): power command +0x35 (0x10 off, 0x11 restart, 0x90 low-voltage off) + constant
0x20 (0x99 bytes) status, default frame, sent only when changed
8-bit sum of bytes 0..len-2 into byte len-1
copy staging -> 0x1456 and return 1 only if different
DISPLAY<->SCI4 bridge: 'Z' len16 frames <-> RT685 ISP packets; starts with 5A A6 ping; F1 82 exits
Key state machine (main_loop): press/short/long/repeat/release tables by key class
Touch (source 4) x position (0..0x316) -> VFO frequency in the scope span
encoder id 2 by screen [inference: multi knob]
encoder id 3 by screen [inference: multi knob]
863 x u8 key class (0 press, 1 short/long, 2 hold/release)
